title: Microsoft Teams: automatic recording and transcription for call queues
summary: The briefing's rollout facts, licensing, opt-in configuration and control paths are supported. Minor corrections should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft reference details, clarify general SharePoint capacity costs and remove a checklist instruction without a corresponding control row.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no tenant-wide automatic-call-queue-recording switch as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams call queue automatic recording tenant wide disable switch policy. Read recording planning/setup, New-CsAutoRecordingTemplate, Set-CsCallQueue and calling-policy search excerpts; no tenant-wide switch for this feature found.

claims.claim: The cited feature pages state no recording-specific consumption meter as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams call queue automatic recording transcription recording price meter SharePoint storage charges. Read recording planning/setup, prerequisites/licensing, Queues app licensing and SharePoint service description; no recording-specific meter found.

claims.claim: The cited feature pages state no recording-specific price as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams call queue automatic recording transcription recording price meter SharePoint storage charges. Read recording planning/setup, prerequisites/licensing, Queues app licensing and SharePoint service description; no recording-specific price found.

claims.claim: The pages cited in the briefing state no SharePoint storage charge specifically for these recordings and transcripts.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams call queue automatic recording transcription recording price meter SharePoint storage charges. Read feature/licensing pages and SharePoint service description and storage management; no feature-specific charge found, but general capacity charges are documented.
claims.fix: Replace the absence sentence with: 'No recording-specific meter or price is stated on the cited feature pages at the time of writing (November 2026). General SharePoint capacity costs still apply: additional capacity can incur charges, including usage-based billing above the tenant quota for eligible tenants.' Add https://learn.microsoft.com/sharepoint/sharepoint-storage-planning to sources. Its current text says 'Additional charges apply' for necessary active content exceeding capacity and describes pay-as-you-go as public preview for commercial tenants, excluding education, GCC and Microsoft 365 operated by 21Vianet.

claims.claim: The feature pages read do not describe cloud-specific differences between GCC and Worldwide automatic-recording experiences.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams automatic recording call queue GCC Worldwide admin center differences. Read recording planning/setup, prerequisites/licensing, Shared Call History setup and Queues app management; no feature-specific GCC UI difference found.

claims.claim: Microsoft's notice says recordings may contain personal data requiring export, deletion or access-request handling.
claims.quote: Recorded calls may contain personal data, which could require handling for export, deletion, or access requests depending on organizational processes.

claims.quote: Recorded calls and transcripts may become subject to eDiscovery, retention, and audit policies depending on organization configuration.

claims.claim: MC1401299 says agents do not control recording, while administrators control agent access to recordings and transcripts.
claims.quote: Agents do not control recording, but admins can control whether agents can access recordings and transcripts.

claims.claim: MC1401299 describes previously ephemeral customer interactions becoming stored recordings and transcripts when enabled.
claims.quote: Customer call interactions that were previously ephemeral are now captured as recordings and transcripts and stored for later access, if feature is enabled.

claims.claim: MC1401299 recommends reviewing recording policies and determining which queues should enable automatic recording.
claims.quote: Review your organization’s call recording and transcription policies.- Determine which Call Queues should enable automatic recording.

claims.claim: The checklist instruction to re-check the template with Get-CsAutoRecordingTemplate has a corresponding controls-table row.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Re-check the template with Get-CsAutoRecordingTemplate'. The table covers template creation, queue assignment, representative access, announcements and Shared Call History; no row covers template inspection.
claims.fix: Replace the final checklist bullet with 'Re-check the queue assignment after any change made in the Teams admin center.' Keep the separate Get-CsAutoRecordingTemplate explanation in Governance controls.
